E0977

An `Image` has no active `from`, or restates a frozen system-inherited field.

What

An `Image` has no active `from`, or restates a frozen system-inherited field.

Why

Active Jetpack images are OCI containers built `from: packages.<name>`; `system.*` disk images are frozen jetos research.

Fix

add `from: packages.<name>` for an `.Oci` image, or remove fields inherited from frozen `system.*` research.
